description: React component for managing and displaying a task dashboard, including fetching, filtering, creating, editing, and deleting tasks.

methods.name: tempId
methods.description: Generates a temporary unique ID for optimistic task creation.

methods.name: statusLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given task status.

methods.name: statusTone
methods.description: Returns a UI tone (color) based on the task status.

methods.name: priorityTone
methods.description: Returns a UI tone (color) based on task priority.

methods.name: nextStatus
methods.description: Determines the next status of a task in the workflow.

methods.name: matchTask
methods.description: Filters tasks based on a search query matching title, description, status, or priority.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of tasks from the API and updates state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates a new task, including an optimistic update, and syncs with server.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates a task with optimistic UI and handles concurrency and error messages.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task, with optimistic UI update and error handling.
